intent_boundary: Reusable spatial constraints for ComicPanelPlan adapters; not a RenderRecord and not an AnimationShotPlan/E-Conte.

camera_profiles.not_animation_camera: Animation camera/e-conte must be a separate record.

occluders.rule: Re-composite this foreground table over actors placed behind it.

anchor_contract.non_contact: Actor influence regions must not overlap unless ComicPanelPlan explicitly declares contact.

adapter_outputs.renderer_reference: Permitted non-final reference input with explicit proxy/control limitations.

freeze_requirements: Canonical controllable set asset with source/license provenance.
Camera calibration against canonical stage rather than generated plate.
Renderer-facing assets and no-change protocol validated independently.
Distinct animation-shot camera/e-conte contract when animation branch begins.
limitations: Legacy plate perspective is approximate and cannot establish canonical 3D grounding.
No actor identity, pose separability, or production acceptance follows from this contract.
Comic spatial cheats remain legitimate when declared in ComicPanelPlan.
